Hi {{{Recipient.FirstName}}},
I am Pastor Paul, School Administrator for AK9I. Thank you for stopping by our booth at the Ft. Bragg job fair. I hope my representative was thorough and informative in explaining our K-9 training programs and the post-graduation employment opportunities that are available to you.
To begin your new career journey and discover your post-military purpose, enrollment is a simple process. Simply fill out the student enrollment form, email it back to me or Michelle Hartman along with a copy of your high school diploma, GED or college transcripts.. Additionally, you can fill out
If you have never applied for your Post 9-11 G.I. Bill education benefits, go to www.va.gov < https://www.va.gov > , fill out and electronically submit VA FORM 22-1990 (initial application for GI Bill benefits). That's really all there is to enroll. We do all the VA processing for you.
We are also approved to accept Skillbridge and VR&E. Classes start the first Monday of every month except July which will be Tuesday July 7.
If you have any additional questions about our K-9 training program and post-graduation employment opportunities, or if you would like to schedule a tour of our facility, please call me or sign up online.
Schedule a Tour < https://outlook.office365.com/book/Bookings@ccasora.onmicrosoft.com/?ismsaljsauthenabled=true >
Warm regards,
Pastor Paul
LT Paul Roushia, USN (Retired)
